title: Electric Field Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the electric field expression from the dipole potential.

title: Force Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly express the force on the charge in terms of the electric field.

title: Mass Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive the expression for mass in terms of charge, dipole moment, and gravitational acceleration.

title: Gradient Application
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the gradient operator to the potential to find the electric field.

title: Pendulum Analogy
description: Important Criteria: The student must clearly relate the motion of the charge to the motion of a pendulum.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign mistakes when calculating forces and fields.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the derivation.

title: Spherical Coordinates
description: Optional Criteria: The student may include a clear explanation of how spherical coordinates are used in the derivation.
